sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the ship target, sh:minCount 2, and the distinct same-ship independence pairing; the current independence topology is otherwise adequate. Repair the power topology: connectedToMainPower and connectedToEmergencyPower are authoritative properties owned by each nonMagneticHeadingMeans, but the candidate only connects each means to arbitrary benchmarkEntity nodes and does not require those nodes to be the specific target ship's main and emergency power sources. Add or locate canonical ship-owned paths/terms for those source nodes, then require each selected means to connect to the corresponding source of the target ship.
